Two components in the patient chart call `useAbortController`. Both pass the controller into their save requests, so a change to the hook's behaviour could affect either one. I found them with a text search of the checkout for the hook name. I didn't open the files or trace the callees, and the end lines below are estimates.

1. `ExportedVitalsAndBiometricsForm` in `esm-patient-vitals-app` calls the hook at line 87. It passes `abortController` at lines 231 and 267, in the save logic.
2. `ExportedLabResultsForm` in `esm-patient-orders-app` calls the hook at line 70. It passes `abortController` to `fetchSavedLabResults(order, abortController)` at line 254. It also passes it at lines 304 and 338, in the save logic.
